Once submitted, your request is fixed. If you need more later, that is a new request — nobody, including the assistant, can widen this one.
Your queries run on Digicow systems. The question comes in, results go back with identifying details removed, and the data itself never travels to your workspace — there is no setting that allows it.
Keys are issued to a named person, not to your organisation. Each one can do what that person is allowed to do, and cannot be passed on.
See summaries; query the documents and logs; submit requests within your agreement.
Digicow has not yet decided how long keys should last, so for now each one expires when you log out.
Shown once. Digicow does not store the key anywhere.

Your agent will be treated as a user in its own right, not as part of your login. It gets its own account and its own permissions, Digicow approves it separately, and automated monitoring applies from its first request. Digicow looks at everything it takes over time — not just one request at a time.
What it may do on its own

children: Required. Digicow will not approve an agent without this.
What happens once it is approved
Digicow approves every agent individually. It is not automatic.
Digicow is reviewing it as a new user in its own right, not as a request under your name. Until they approve it, the agent has no key, no permissions and no way to make a request.
against what this agent is allowed in total
Digicow watches the total, not just each request. Many small requests that are each fine on their own, but together add up to something you are not allowed to have, will be caught here.
Stops everything it is doing, and anything new, immediately.
Paused. Two requests were running and both stopped where they were — each recorded as stopped, neither quietly finished. Nothing was deleted.

You can register your own computers, but nothing that touches Digicow data will ever run on them. All work on the data happens on Digicow computers, next to the data. Your own are for what you do with a model or file after you have collected it.
Digicow computers available for your work
Usage is counted per request and checked against your spending limit before anything runs. A request that would go over it is sent to a person to approve rather than run and billed anyway.
Models and recipes you have registered

The fingerprint taken when an item arrives is quoted again when your trained model is released, so you can be sure it is the same thing. Your ownership of what you bring is recorded on the way in and confirmed on the way out.
Digicow has not set its rates yet, so nothing here shows a price. Your usage is still counted precisely — what, how much, and when — so it can be billed correctly once rates are set.
